description: CME futures minute bars from Massive (massive.com), one UTC day at a time, stitched into one series per root by volume (the previous weekday's, so no look-ahead; never back to an earlier contract; one contract per day), kept current every 6 hours. Every candidate contract's own bars are kept for audit, and every roll is logged. Name the instance cme: its folder raw/cme/massive/cme is the one the Register-hypothesis form joins with the imported cache. Needs the Massive key stored in Settings as provider Other, slug massive (the secret field can be any placeholder).

roots.title: Products
roots.description: Product roots. ES and NQ also serve MES and MNQ (the same prices); MGC is its own series.

start.title: First day (UTC, YYYY-MM-DD)
start.description: Default 2026-09-14, the Monday after the imported cache ends. Massive serves about two years back.
